en-US.description: A viewer, converter and printing software for 2D DWG, DXF, 3D STEP and 2D/3D VariCAD file formats.
en-US.longDescription: VariCAD Viewer is a viewer, converter and printing software working with 2D DWG, DXF, 3D STEP and 2D/3D VariCAD file formats. VariCAD viewer allows you to convert DWG to DXF and vice-versa, convert STEP to 3D IGES or STL formats, print 2D DWG, DXF or VariCAD formats and use batch print or batch conversions. All conversions are also available between VariCAD native format and other listed formats. VariCAD viewer offers settings of 3D display methods (like light source or perspective). 3D display can be also exported into high-resolution bitmap file. You can try a 30-day free trial of VariCAD Viewer.
en-US.name: VariCAD Viewer

zh-CN.description: 一款支持 2D DWG、DXF、3D STEP 及 2D/3D VariCAD 文件格式的查看器、转换器和打印工具。
zh-CN.longDescription: VariCAD Viewer 是一款支持 2D DWG、DXF、3D STEP 及 2D/3D VariCAD 文件格式的查看器、转换器和打印工具。该软件可实现 DWG 与 DXF 格式互转，将 STEP 转换为 3D IGES 或 STL 格式，支持 2D DWG/DXF/VariCAD 文件打印，并能进行批量打印或批量格式转换。所有转换功能同样适用于 VariCAD 原生格式与其他所列格式之间的转换。VariCAD Viewer 提供 3D 显示模式设置（如光源和透视效果），还可将 3D 视图导出为高分辨率位图文件。用户可下载 30 天免费试用版体验。
